name: angle-slider
title: Angle Slider
description: A circular dial slider for selecting an angle value, controlled by arrow keys or dragging the thumb around the track.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible label for the slider thumb.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element that labels the slider thumb.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value of the slider.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the slider.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description:
The ids of the elements in the machine.
Useful for composition.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the slider. Useful for form submission.

props.name: step
props.description: The step value for the slider.

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: The callback function for when the value changes.

events.name: onValueChangeEnd
events.description: The callback function for when the value changes ends.

examples.title: Basic
examples.description: An uncontrolled angle slider with an initial value.

examples.title: Step
examples.description: Pass `step` to snap the value to fixed degree increments while dragging.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: A disabled slider is skipped by the tab order and ignores pointer input.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import AngleSlider from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/angle-slider/angle-slider.marko";
Value: ${value}°
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange` to track updates.
